name: ai-wordpress-builder
description: AI-native website builder that operates real WordPress via Docker.

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/agent && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/agent && npm run typecheck -w apps/web && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/agent && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/agent && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:unit -w packages/shared && npm run test:unit -w apps/agent && npm run test:unit -w apps/web
scripts.test:watch: concurrently -n shared,agent,web -c blue,magenta,green "npm run test:watch -w packages/shared" "npm run test:watch -w apps/agent" "npm run test:watch -w apps/web"
